app-connection.staging_workspace_description: Every site that uses this workspace ID shows the surveys published here to real visitors. To try surveys and actions without reaching them, create a second workspace in this organization, put its ID in your staging or local site, and build there. When a survey is ready, open its menu in the survey list and choose Copy to... to copy it into this workspace as a draft: code actions are matched by key, and missing ones are created. The copy keeps the questions, styling, triggers, audience and languages, but its display and response settings go back to their defaults (the share of users it shows to, delay, auto close, response limit, PIN, email verification, spam protection, and the publish and close dates), so review them in the survey editor before you publish. Responses and contacts stay in the workspace that collected them.

sdk_identity.usage_description: Compute the HMAC-SHA256 of the user ID under the secret on your server, then pass it to setUserId with the user ID.
